scope: Focused follow-up of foreground latency and shared-speaker continuity; no new model calls

findings.decision: Do not forward provisional deltas to speech. The final reply can differ or fail; speaking cannot be retracted. Existing confirmed spoken_update uses one interruptible handle.
Keep household device scope. No verified speaker/listener handoff exists. Bound private Telegram is the existing private continuation route; a device-to-owner alias would not satisfy the requirement.

next: Separate model processing latency from channel delivery. Existing low-versus-none and catalog comparisons are negative evidence; do not repeat unchanged trials. Physical Voice PE trial awaits owner presence; independent functional work remains available.
